purpose: Teach: 照らし/記さ/屈し/残留/広範囲/生じる/通念/護衛

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のロゴが照らした業界、評価上昇中だ
lines.en: Our company's reputation in the industry is rising steadily.
lines.style: Measured and assured. Opens with quiet authority. Even pace, each phrase weighted. No inflection for emphasis—the confidence carries it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業時、社訓に記された理念を守っております
lines.en: Yes. We're upholding the principles that were set down in our founding charter.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Sits slightly forward. Steady rhythm. Each clause lands with small deliberate pauses, showing attentiveness to the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正に屈しない方針を貫け
lines.en: The company will not compromise its integrity. Hold that line.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Sharp attack on the opening word. Commands respect without raising volume. Leans back slightly—command-voice that expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。残留した古い在庫を処分中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently disposing of outdated inventory.
lines.style: Factual report. Quiet efficiency. No apology in the tone, just clear execution. Slightly clipped pace—checking boxes, moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広範囲な販路を確保しろ
lines.style: Short, purposeful directive. Crisp edge. Pause before speaking—selecting the words like orders. Expects action, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に生じる負担を軽減しております
lines.en: Yes. We're reducing the workload burden on our staff.
lines.style: Calm report. Slight warmth underneath the professionalism—this matters. Moderate pace, almost gentle. Shows he's thinking of people, not just policy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の通念にとらわれず進化しろ
lines.en: Progress without being bound by industry convention.
lines.style: Philosophical conviction. Slow, deliberate opening. Slight lift on 'progress'—this is the vision. The tone suggests he's thought about this deeply. Trailing pause at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。要人来社時の護衛、手配済みです
lines.en: Yes. Security arrangements for the executive visit are confirmed.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Brief, professional. Quiet satisfaction—details handled. Small nod implicit in the delivery. Ends with finality.
